methodology.workspace_operations: All case declarations from WorkspaceOperation.swift; application operation names are not necessarily RPC methods.
methodology.central_mapping: Exact Swift case-block excerpts from the stock route function and native plugin route function. Missing mappings use another client or are unsupported/retained; no automatic fallback.
methodology.http_literals: Lexical /api/ and /auth/ string literals from all non-Fixtures, non-Demo Swift files in Bighelp/. Source interpolation and prefix expressions are preserved, not expanded into an invented API.
methodology.protocol_name_literals: Lexical dotted protocol-family names; includes RPC/event/config labels and retained paths. Not all names are callable RPC methods.
methodology.swift_types: Source pointers to types in route-bearing/contract-focused files, not a generated complete Swift AST/schema.
methodology.plugin_routes: AST decorator extraction plus explicit workflow/wiki registries; prefixes resolved from mounted routers. {operation} endpoints stay dynamic and finite operations are documented separately.
methodology.plugin_models: Exact Python model excerpts from mounted API/native boundary modules; inheritance/validators/helper modules still matter.
limitations: No application or server was run.
No complete Hermes server checkout/version was audited; current Mac clients define this scope.
Not OpenAPI, a generated SDK, endpoint reachability proof, or permission to restore retired UI.
Review referenced codecs, validators, capability gates and tests before implementing any operation.
